cases.summary: The project could not be opened.
cases.consequence: Editing did not begin and project data was not changed.
cases.suggested_fix: Locate the project folder or repair project.json.

cases.summary: The map could not be saved.
cases.suggested_fix: Check the destination permissions, then retry without closing the editor.

cases.summary: The external document was not reloaded.
cases.consequence: The validated local draft remains active.
cases.suggested_fix: Compare both versions and repair the malformed external file.

cases.summary: This project version cannot be migrated yet.
cases.consequence: The project remains unchanged at its current version.
cases.suggested_fix: Restore the supported backup or install the required migration step.

cases.summary: Playtest cannot start while blocking diagnostics remain.
cases.suggested_fix: Open Project Health and resolve the blocking items.

cases.summary: The project is not ready to package.
cases.suggested_fix: Open export validation and resolve each blocking requirement.
